prompt: A high fixed view from a rafter corner of a cramped rented attic with a sloping ceiling. Brandon sits on the floor in the centre of the frame, small from above, leaning back against a stained mattress, surrounded by a heap of cheap chemist bottles and blister packs in white, orange and blue. His head is tipped back, his right hand is raised to his open mouth, his brows are pulled up and together and his eyes are watering and wide. A bare bulb on a flex hangs from a beam and a small skylight lets in a patch of dull orange night sky. Grainy night-mode texture, muted colours. Thanks.
